maya: quick heads-up: planning header-based routing cutover in 20m. need api/runtime/console/router ack and fallback confirmations.
jon: runtime ack. will roll kernel-14 as canary binary. warming LRU cache now.
liam: console ack. freezing web deploys and disabling migrations. will show internal banner if we hit issues.
kate: api ack. feature gated behind X-NewRoute; will pin previous v2.4.5 as fallback.
ravi: router ack. will shadow 12% traffic then shift 8% every 3m. health probe at 1s.
deploybot: Deploy created: api:v2.5.0, runtime:kernel-14, console:static-2026-03-23c, router:hdr-switch-2026. Canary plan attached: /deploy/7090909090
jon: note: kernel-14 changes batching behavior. expect small p50 improvements but watch p99.
maya: proposed rollback triggers: (1) p99 > 2.5x baseline for 3m, (2) error rate >1% for 2m, (3) any schema mismatch in responses >0.25% for 1m.
kate: agree. also capture failing request IDs for debugging and auto-replay.
ravi: router will auto-pause at 10% if backend 5xx >0.4% over 1m. manual hold at /ops/router/hold
ops-bot: Quiet window active: 2026-03-23T07:15Z - 2026-03-23T08:15Z. Paging: jon, anjali, liam.
maya: confirm fallbacks: api->v2.4.5, runtime->kernel-13-compat, console->static-2026-03-22. react with :thumbsup: if ready.
